labels.cult_elixir_active: A preparation quickens their sittings ×{factor} for {hours} more hours
labels.cult_longevity: A longevity elixir gave them {years} more years
labels.cause_herb_deep_qi: the tree's qi had grown deep enough
labels.cause_herb_shade: the tree's qi reached into the shade
labels.cause_herb_scar: Heaven's lightning had scorched the earth
labels.cause_herb_waterside: winter came to the water's edge
labels.function_help_herbal_workshop: Herbalist's workshop: a medicine mortar and a drying rack under a roof, with a door (tier 1, one crafter). Anyone may brew healing draughts and awakening tea here from spirit herbs, berries and grain.
labels.function_help_alchemy_hall: Alchemy hall: two or more alchemy furnaces, a medicine cabinet and a drying rack under a roof, with a door (tier 3, a crafter at each furnace, up to four). Adds thunder-warding and marrow-cleansing pills, and fewer batches fail.
labels.function_help_pill_pavilion: Pill pavilion: a great cauldron, three or more furnaces, two medicine cabinets and a mortar under a roof, with a door, 30 cells of roofed floor and the tree's qi at 0.4 or more (tier 4, up to eight crafters). Adds the longevity elixir; the cauldron sometimes yields one more.
labels.function_help_herb_garden: Herb garden: four or more herb beds where the tree's qi is 0.3 or more. Empty beds sprout spirit herbs under the open sky and jade ginseng in shade, and ripen half again as fast.
